An achievement for 100%It was once two establishments, divided as much by culture as their shared wall. On one side, the touted second home of mammals, though its true clientele included any carnivore. It is a poorly kept secret that it was not owned by a stoat, but a marten. On the other, a home for intellectuals and creatives, those whose vices lie in the mind, more than the mouth. Its proprietor was indeed a magpie, when they could still be found. Despite the stigma carnivores face, it was never an intense rivalry, and some frequented both establishments, ferrying drink, news, and most daringly food, across suggested borders. Disparate communities often find solidarity under oppression, seek to rectify differences. At least, here they could. Its divide is now only a faint architectural memory where a wall once was, a variety of designs mingling freely in the large hall, only differentiated at the two counters, where one can order their respective mode of escapism. <<if $acumen >= 1>>\ <<acumenTalk "Medium">> It is, almost, a clan. His words disappear into a breathy whimper, before he steels himself once more. "I'm rooting for you." "[[I'm trying.]]" "[[Thank you.]]"A wave of emotion washes over you, disinfecting your spirit. Now the decision is made, you've never felt so... peaceful. Happy, ecstatic even! You want to jump up and tell someone, you want to hug anyone and cry. Wow. This has all been stupidly and unnecessarily difficult. And now it's finally going to be done. No more nightmares, no more giving your all to make it through just one more hour. The future doesn't scare you anymore, because there is no future. [[(Trust in liquid encouragement.)|Drink and write]] [[(Force through.)]] [[(Give up on writing.)|Give up writing]]<<set $homeTimePassed to $homeTimePassed + 1>>\ Among medical supplies, bottles of pills, spare writing equipment, and a seldom used bottle of perfume, is a carefully folded sheet of paper. It has been torn from the same paper that fills the journal you keep in your jacket. <<if $psyche >= 2>>\ <<include [[You are recovered]]>> <<else>>\ <<include [[Psyche warns you away]]>> <</if>>\ <<if $heart >= 2>>\ <<include [[It's important]]>> <<else>>\ <<include [[Don't want to see this]]>> <</if>>\ <<if $psyche >= 2 or $heart >= 2>> [[(Read it.)|Read positive journal]] <<else>>\ [[(Read it.)|Psyche stops you reading]] <</if>>\ [[(Let it rest.)]]The medicine is fast acting. Soon, you are //free//. The fears are vanquished, and emotions flow freely in more dimensions than you are able to wield unaided. Your body is a conduit for an otherworldly energy, and you are now ready to unleash it. Impossible questions have such simple solutions: To hell with tact! Cast coherence to the depths of the eastern chimney! You have compromised enough of yourself already, you will stay true at least here. Replaying some faintly remembered songs in your mind, you are in the perfect creative mindset. While swaying and singing along to these imagined songs, you jot down faint memories from your childhood, dreams, hopes, unfiltered agony, the scraps of stories you burned away, conversations, and most importantly, passion. [[Continue|Depths of the bottle]]No; you are not a thrall to chemical aids. You refuse to be defined by them, for now. With enough forceful hard work, unnatural dedication, and stubborn refusal to reevaluate your course, you must, eventually, get there. It must make you happy, it has to. [[Continue|Force 2]]You wake only a few hours later from horrible nightmares, visions of unattainable happiness, and the imagined sound of the world exploding. There is no hangover, you're gifted in avoiding those, but you will not sleep well for many days. You are an anxious, quaking wreck, hating what you've done to yourself, hating who you are. You long for that earlier high to return and stay, a longing held in contention against the destruction it does to your already failing body and mind. Maybe a life cut short but lived happy is worth it, you wonder. [[Continue|Why can't this be]]<<if $psyche <= 1>>\ <<include [[Cut your losses]]>> <<else>>\ <<include [[It deserves love]]>> <</if>>\ <<include [[Home options]]>><<set $homeTimePassed to $homeTimePassed + 1>>\ Sitting at the desk, your mind branches out to the scattered pages before you without waiting for permission. It collates them at a variety of scopes, finding meaning in the arching themes and in words not used. Something is not quite right. Something deeper than the obvious, surface level wounds used to ink these pages. There's a fundamental discomfort here. <<if $heart >= 2>>\ <<include [[Echolocation]]>> <</if>>\ <<include [[Story options]]>><<set $askedWhatWriting to true>>\ It is, sometimes, non-fiction. There is no start, and there is no end, it just keeps happening. The audience is you, the protagonist is you, and the extras are you. The world is yours, and you belong to it. <<include [[Story options]]>><<set $askedWhyWriting to true>>\ It is not accurate to say that you're writing it. It's a side effect. The shape and meaning is born in the reality that it is cut from. Its passages creak in misery as it bears the weight of a reality folding inwards. You are terrified. <<include [[Story options]]>><<set $askedIfSuccessful to true>>\ A meaningless question. In this instant, you have exactly five different answers. They are all completely contrasting, and entirely correct. Yesterday, you had five different answers. Some drastically different, some almost identical but never quite. Even as you consider this, your answers are changing. There isn't a correct answer, only a dancing gradient of dozens of dimensions. In compressing it to a single word, you only further lose touch with its meaning. <<include [[Story options]]>><<set $askedWhoReadStory to true>>\ You do. <<include [[Story options]]>><<set $askedWhatScaredOf to true>>\ The three and one that act powerfully, and unseen. The unintended messages you find in your work after hours. Phantoms. Your visage, sketched in charcoal, smiling, stuck to a rock obelisk, and forgotten. <<include [[Story options]]>>The pen is an extension of your circulatory system, and it is vital to your revival. The ichor of your being flows from its tip with each unwilling pulse. It comes with an impossible agony, one you only cultivate with each scratch against the page. You tear out sutures holding in memories best forgotten; there is comfort in your suffering, and uncertainty in happiness or death. This story is a piece of you, and It is alive. You have tortured It into being so that It might be your Passion and unshackle you from Damnation. <<heartTalk "Extreme">> And now, two are in Hell. [[Continue|Finish writing successfully]]You look up into a swirling mass of meaningless shapes and sounds. Your eyes are glazed. Your face is soaked. You are shaking. You have not eaten. You cannot know how long it has been. The world away from the page is foreign, and defies resolving into meaningful patterns. You have never felt a fatigue so intense, as though the planet had flipped around, and is now bearing down on you alone. [[(Awake.)|Sleep after writing]]Somehow, you find yourself in bed. You do not remember how you got here. Your world is shaking, and you have imagined it is exploding. You drift through the cosmos on your mattress, glaring up at the stars, trying to find answers in their ancient wisdom. They reply with the fundamental truth supporting the impossible burden of life: Nothing. It doesn't mean anything. It just happens. If you want meaning, you have to make it. Faced with the impossible black threatening to overrun you, there is only one option: Ascend. Join the constellations. Your body the spark, your passion the fuel. You must burn. <<endRun "Hiding">>"[[I found someone I loved more than anything. A sharp inhale, a shaky exhale punctuated by a muted yelp, then decades of repressed pain are unleashed. His face is buried firmly in your shoulder, and the tears spread warmly in your shirt. His cries are loud beside your ear, and he shakes with a violence enough to make remaining upright difficult. [[(Comfort him.)]]"I have sometimes but, it doesn't come natural to me. You search those feelings for any kind of touch that might soothe his soul; a scratch to the shoulder, a stroke along the spine, a tight hug around the waist. 'You are safe. You are enough. You are loved', you speak in the language of your body. Slowly, cautiously, the war inside of him fades. His clutch loosens, wails become the occasional sniffle. Songs used: Some friends who had to read contextless writing that probably ruined the story for them, and listened to me whine for half a year: Clint, Ivy, Dani, Skyler, Pika. You! If you're not sure this is you, it isn't. They know who they are. Is this about you? No, it isn't. Books: Kay Redfield Jamison - An Unquiet Mind: The personal story of a psychologist with bipolar disorder. Her insights were enlightening. Viktor E. Frankl - Man's Search For Meaning: A harrowing tale of an experience in concentration camps, and the psychology of the author and his peers. Logotherapy was my introduction to psychotherapy. Bassel A. van der Kolk - The Body Keeps a Score: The book about trauma, what it does. These songs had some lyrics that connected with me so well parts of my writing was directly inspired: La Dispute - The Last Lost Continent: The chorus at about 4:50 is truly beautiful. La Dispute - Andria: A beautiful song about remembering the best and worst parts of someone you loved and lost. It has such a mess of emotions - pain, regret, happiness, acceptance, denial. It perfectly captures keeping someone alive in your memories. Aesop Rock - Dorks: I listened to an unholy amount of Aesop when I needed to get abstract. They've consistently been my greatest inspiration for poetic writing. Will Wood and the Tapeworms - Dr Sunshine is Dead: This whole album is a great exploration of someone completely losing themselves, and needing to rediscover who they are. Black Country, New Road - Bread Song: These depressed britons carried me through a particularly bad period of the year, and got me back into playing music. Sufjan Stevens - I Want To Be Well Tyler, The Creator - Puppet: This song, and its album, have been a recurring amulet of strength over the years. The album is a great exploration of a particular type of toxic relationship, and how easy it is to fall back into. Car Seat Headrest - Famous Prophets (Stars): The world does not end when love leaves. But it certainly feels like it. Jhariah - Pin-eye: Another song from a stellar album. This one's about the burden of aspiration, how easily you can shred yourself in its pursuit, and the compromise the musician comes to with it. Bright Eyes - Lua: A song that followed my teenage years, and continues to be a fine capture of living a life without joy. Goreshit - O'er The Flood: An instrumental breakcore song. I found it from a Team Fortress 2 montage back in the day. It has a lot of meaning to me. It has been my theme for trying in spite of the world, for the past seven years. There is a loneliness to its optimism. It is settling for a world that is good enough. <a href="https://youtu.be/vSbP8cm2zio" target="_blank">Empire! Empire! (I Was A Lonely Estate) - Actually, I'm Just Wearing Your Glasses</a>: This band is a capture of teenage angst that still sometimes wells up in me. Mogwai - Music For A Forgotten Future: I listened to this song and similar from their discography constantly. I feel that they capture the sad mundanity of life at a baseline of unhappiness, in a world you don't like and can't escape. Will Stetson - Kyu-kurarin: ADHD depressed weeb music, translated! Seriously though, it's a wonderfully chaotic and upbeat representation of fighting depression. Will did an excellent job with the vocals and rhythm, the instrumentation is a brilliant mirror of the mindset. acloudyskye - Team https://youtu.be/v-YzFFe5xeY: It's hard to choose just one song, their whole discography speaks to me. Particularly alongside their characters, animations, and overarching story. A lot of their songs touch on the bittersweet reality of allowing yourself to trust someone. If you like this song, check out Ditch as well. And then Overthrower. And then check out everything else! :) Some other inspirations: Somewhat inspired by Disco Elysium, a game about <span class="obscured-text">ᛐᛡᛂ×ᛌᛆᛍᛂᛚᛂᛍᛍ×ᛆᚵᚮᚿᚤ×ᚮᚠ×ᛔᛂᚱᛍᛁᛍᛐᛂᚿᛌᛂ</span> I'm sure I read this somewhere, I think it was the lead writer of Disco Elysium. He said something like, "I poured every drop of anger and pain into this, and I hope that comes through." I love that. I hate that I can't find the quote! It really helped me accept what it was I was writing, to be true to myself and to use it as an outlet for //me// before anything else. There was love, here.Rey gets sloshed with protag, and starts to behave strangely.'Emotional pain isn't too dissimilar to physical pain. Every synapse that dares fire is another pike through my chest. Everything is strangled by the smog coming from the smouldering remains of my life. Normally, it's too hard to write my feelings down. Who gives a shit about documenting what's happening? My world is ending. Fuck posterity. And when the fire settles, I don't want to revisit it. If the fire settles. I hate myself so much. I miss you so much. I'm just another scar on your past. I'm one more thing you ran from. I'm something to forget. I failed you. I'm so sorry. I'm so sorry.' [[Continue|Relapsed]]You erase the night from your mind as it happens. It lasts an eternity. You have no more breath. There are no more tears left. Your face is perpetual terror. You silently cradle yourself. Your lip bleeds. There is no future like this. You have nothing left.Today won't be it. You are planted on your back. You stare at the ceiling. [[Continue|Restless]]Your body is uncomfortable. You roll over. Neither side is comfortable. [[Continue|Rolling]]You roll over again. And again, for good measure. Your blanket switches from atop you, to below you, to coiled among your limbs. Finally, it is on the floor, as are your pillows. You stare at the ceiling, knees slightly bent, hands on your stomach. You are not tired. You are not energetic. What are you? You're uncomfortable, on every layer of your being. [[Continue|Spiralling]]If it moves with any speed, it travels in hopping arches, changing direction explosively and without reason. So much more worse than you had realized in your tiny world that has you at the center. What came out of your mouth next was a series of mistakes. The vulnerability hidden in your assault was deftly exploited. You did not realize it at the time, but you had been disarmed, dismembered, then destroyed. Now it punctures every dreamscape. There is nothing more you can do than toy with the stories in your mind, twisting tales where everything is going to be okay, and nothing could ever ruin this. [[I was just one of their many victims.|They were cruel]] [[I need to forget.|Doesn't matter]] [[I deserve this. It happened because of me.|My fault]]After all of this - what even are you, anymore? [[I am a void of shattered emotion. I must cast these remains aside, and build a machine in their place.]] [[I'm a bloodied heap. I was made to suffer. I have no option but to fight.]]It feels like you could sit here forever, become a part of this patch of simple life, living for the sake of it. If only the cold wouldn't creep in. If only the hunger didn't grow even worse, and your throat wouldn't dry up. If only we could be silent. This... is pretty good. When life finds out where you've fled and catches up, you're going to go back. We don't think it's going to get better than this. Maybe this is a good point to finish this story, while you're happy - we think this is happy. <<include [[Resist urge]]>>Even though he was there for you as much as he could ever have been, he'll scan every memory you had together, wondering what he could have done differently. And he'll sit on your bed, imagining all the times you curled up here in indescribable pain, and do the same. And he'll skim your books, and wonder how you felt when you read them. He'll wish more than anything he could listen to your empassioned analyses just once more, even though he rarely understood them. He'll dream of you often. Simple dreams, the two of you playing board games, or sitting at this very overlook together, and you'll be happy in them. Each time, he'll lie there for the hour, and quietly suffer. He'll remember your face. How it was before you were found. How he would have given anything for one more moment. And he will never be the same again. [[I just want to escape. Why can't they just let me go? They're keeping me caged!|I just want to escape]]His love is a burden. There's no easy way out of this, unfortunately. Every route has a cost. And this one's cost is too great for today. Life is coming for you. It's pulling you back. You're shaking - are you cold? You must have been here for a while. You probably scared off some poor kids, watching you weigh up your pact with gravity. You probably scarred them. Come on. It's time to go home. [[(Go home.)]]They will be. And then there are the others. The dozens of people you've found, and lost. Those who probably never think of you, may never learn what happened, but you refuse to forget them. They all mattered, and they all made this worthwhile. [[I hope they know I thought of them.|I hope they knew I cared.]]Once you're gone, he'll look through your house, and he'll piece together the life you hid from him. He'll read your journal, he'll read your unfinished works, and he'll feel responsible. He'll feel a vicious agony much greater than you could ever have imagined. [[No, please. This was going well. Don't ruin this.|This was going well]]They might think so, sometimes. And at the top of those friends your closest, Rey, who was always there, always cared more than you deserved. He never left you. It's been a while since you spoke. That won't make it easier. [[I hope he understands this is what I want.|I hope he understands]]You first walk, then climb down the long rocky slope. It's not that far down, this path is not that steep, but such physical adventures are novel to you, when was the last time you //climbed// anything? You lose your footing more than once, rocks tumble free, disappear into the foliage below, your vice grip the only reason you fail to follow their freedom. Tomorrow, today, yesterday and all that lies beyond. You are forced into living it, and it takes joy in your torture. Nothing good awaits you, yet life is here, tearing you into consciousness, thrusting you forward with biological necessities. It does not care how you feel or what you want. You will live, until you don't. Your only escape is here, below the covers, in the dark. You retreat here as often as you can convince your body to follow. You've been through this countless times. How much longer can you keep this up? When will you be free? Or is this all your life is now? [[Everyone deals with this. I'm being overly dramatic.]] [[I wasn't always this way. I was stronger.]] [[I'm only scared because I allow myself to be scared. As you gracefully tip the ever lighter container towards your glass, you spy, incredibly astutely I might add, a hand of white fur blocking its opening. "Hey... I think we should go home." You tilt your head towards the culprit. The motion is certainly majestic, beautiful, calmer and more relaxed than anyone could imagine capable. He must be impressed with this. This husk clings to you and puppets your limbs and heart, you control is far from absolute. But it needs to go. There is a power in you that has been held back for far too long by ideals of kindness and acceptance. Free yourself from the shackles of others. Tune yourself to the fundamentals of the universe, and bend them to your understanding.You will bite down on the pulse of life and you will survive at all costs."I think we'll get through this. He doesn't expect an answer, and he doesn't wait for one. Just goes back to sitting, thinking. You want this moment to last forever. Kicked back, reflecting on the past, curious about the future, in the company of someone who understands. If this were a story, it's where you'd make the credits roll. But life isn't so simple. Once these credits roll, you have to go home. You'll need to go back to work, sometime soon. This moment may come up now and again, but in the end, it's just one part of a larger life. For worse, and for better. You're brought back to reality by a light touch on your forearm, and a slight smile in response to your start. "You wanna head back?" "[[Not really. He holds you by your wrist as he brings the both of you to stand. "Let's get back before we start freezing." [[(Head back home.)|Walk home together]]You go past his house, but the two of you keep going without a word. Reaching your door, there's a silence. "I'll see ya around?" "[[See ya, Rey.]]"You spend a long time laying there in the dark, thinking. It's not clear about what, but it doesn't hurt like it usually does. [[Continue|Not meant to be a poem]]<<acumenTalk "">> I once fought for the day everything would turn out alright. [[Continue|Not meant to be a poem]]<<heartTalk "">>It's quite strange, really. It's a conversation I will replay a thousand times, full of warm delight, the sound of rain, the setting of the sun. It's the motivation to beat the first morning chirp of the birds. It's a night spent mouth wide, eyes fixed to a different realm, trying desperately to survive one more moment. It's the thumping drum that underscores my melody, creating a woven fabric of colour and smell. It's a cause to drink. It's a soulful cry of all that could have been, kept alive only in the echoes of our prison. It's a flutter in the chest - Or, is that the stress? It's a mangled wound that reopens at the slightest touch. Self inflicted. It's the fatal flaw in my construction that will be my grizzly and prompt demise. It's a brilliant promise held up to the light, scattering billions of possibilities. It's fucking hopeless and I can't keep it up! [[Continue|Not meant to be a poem]]It wasn't meant to be a poem. Your breath is wet and warm on your concealed face, your eyes are shielded with glass armour. You look to the sky, to the imprisoning black clouds, illuminated only by the bolts of lightning that bounce around within the charged air, the only source of light, that flickering blue. Today is a clear day. The blizzard is only mild, the winds are not overwhelming. There are no footprints but your own. This deep into the city, the crystalized sculptures of its inhabitants are largely untouched by scavenger or predator. They pierce you with languished eyes. You want to smash them so you might have a moment of privacy, but your training grounds you. A boom cracks across the land, a spike is punctured through the clouds, debris from above slams into the surface only a few hundred meters from you. Like a rock thrown into water, the snow splashes up into a great cloud, consuming you as a wave swallows a lolloping leaf. Your ears are ringing, you have been tossed to the floor. The sound seems to be repeating in your mind - no, wait, it isn't in your mind, it's happening. A building is toppling not far from you, a chunk of rock descends from the obscuring fog, and cracks your goggles. From repeated trauma to your greatest weaknesses, you have been fundamentally altered. [[Continue|What you no longer have]]For months, every shred of pain and spike of anger I felt went into that story. It was the only place it could go. I started to see how important it is to not leave ideas half finished, passages half written. Sometimes, if it's really important, I will come back and revamp a passage, but it takes a lot more work for me to rewrite something than it does to just write something new. Related, I started to accept that sometimes, it's okay to be lazy! Sure, it's nice if I can make everything my best writing ever. But the simple fact is, not every passage is going to hit for everyone. I have strengths in writing, and I have weaknesses. Trying to force everything to be equal quality means the smallest passages can take weeks. Would it be nice if every single choice lead to a totally unique path? For sure, I'd love that. Her life could have been saved. With better equipment. With better funding. Maybe, if you had started work a day earlier, ''you'' could have saved her. But he does not need to know this. Now, it is too late. "No. We could wake her up for a bit longer, but it would be for maybe a couple of days, and those days would be spent in agony. We've done all we can to ensure she isn't in pain, but we have exhausted all of our options for treatment. She may have minutes, or she may have days. She may be able to understand what's happening right now, or she may not." He stands there, mouth parted slightly, but does not make a sound. Then a sharp breath in, a quivering one out. His eyes start to shimmer. "Okay." [[Give him time.]]He is trying his hardest to control himself. The emotions come slow at first. A lip bitten. A sniffle. Shoulders tensed. Face dipped. Sounds grasping at words, failing. "What do I do now? She's here, and she's not dead, and she's going to die, and I'm here, and what do you do now? What do I do?" It's hard to understand him. His speech is stuttered, repeated, quiet, breathy. His arms are clasped to his chest, his hands hide his mouth, in the unconscious shape of a prayer. [[The ritual.]]"There's a ritual some of us follow here, when we say goodbye. 'Thank you. I forgive you. I hope you forgive me. I love you.'" He does not say anything back. A lifetime together is reaping its dues, demanding each fragment of love back in the form of pain. [[Check what he needs.]]"I'm going to give you some time alone, now. There's staff just outside this door. If you need anything, we're here for you." You do not see him move from his spot. You cannot bear to observe him any longer. Your shield is slipping, and he does not need that. You may never see him again. You will have to do this hundreds more times in your life. It does not get easier. "He take it well?" The roar of a train coming into station briefly drowns out all thought, until you need to cover your ears and close your eyes. Balconies are the sole visible amenity, a mixture of personalities fighting over each other for the shared land. Some hang flags that have no meaning to you, others have stern posters that cannot be read from a distance. One balcony is entirely claimed by a mural spanning the length of the block. What people say matters, you are fundamentally terrified of what they might utter if you dare show your face again. Or, worse, what they won't say ever again. Maybe if you sequester for long enough, someone will remember you, and you'll know who //really// cares. So far? Nobody. There might have been a knock at the door, or you might have imagined someone cared. Once, you gave it freely. It was how you wanted to be, distinct from the jaded and cynical peers that spread bitterness in every encounter. But your naive self had never realized how quickly someone could change, or how truly little you could understand those you trust. Do you remember that one, what was his name... Bramble? You had confided so much in him. You had always tried to give him your best. You respected him. In your moment of need, where is he? Off chasing a fleeting fancy on some blank slate. Their feelings held no room for the bond you had tried to forge. Now, you see the two of them doing what the two of you used to do, from a distance, while you suffer. You were replaceable, and you learned at the worst possible moment. Your trust has been best placed at the bottom of a bottle. You can trust in vice; it has no tongue to lie about its intentions to kill. [[Continue|Home]]<<addSkill "heart" 1>>\ <span class="heartColor">+ Effusive Heart</span> <<addSkill "acumen" 1>>\ <span class="acumenColor">+ Plastic Acumen</span> <<addSkill "psyche" 1>>\ <span class="psycheColor">+ Indomitable Psyche</span> They were your escape. Helping them let you forget about your own problems for a while. It gave you perspective. It made you feel useful, it was your will to live. You were like a detective from a noir novel, solving other peoples' lives to escape your own past. Or at least, that's how you romanticized it. Now the cases have run cold. You have no purpose. Psychological debt has caught up, and the collectors are repossessing your faculties. [[Continue|Home]]It's not impressive, not compared to what you've treated in others. Really, in spite of its flavour variety, it's just two substances: Analgesics, neurotoxins. But you never considered yourself much of a chef. Their recipe is beautiful. In a moment spanning minutes, you are born anew. Hot, sweaty, regularly needing to piss, but free. Free of anxiety, free of pain, the marks no longer ask to be spared! The dosage increases regularly. You are an experiment - you jot down your regression, hoping that in reaching your limits, you might educate the wider world on the correct way to escape its turmoil. Plus, if your heart stops, it might explain why. Jeez, is anyone going to understand this? Of the twenty people who read it, if that? Probably not. But you consider yourself a scientist, and this rigorous torture is justified in the scientific process, to you. New experiences, knowledge, regardless of its source. There is nothing. God, you're so free. Free to do anything, and all you want to do is lay here, and think of music, and think about how no one will ever understand that simple desire. It's all so stupid. Chemicals gone awry, and now brought back into control with a simple cocktail. This is how it should be. This is how it should remain. What's the point in anything else? We're all doomed anyway! Let it happen. Let it consume you. Let it be. Let go. Just let go. This is not happiness. But it is the closest thing available, and you need it. Nobody else understands that. As your curl up, you can't feel your calves working. That's how you like it. Keep trying! You can escape this body, this soul, this world! Somewhere in the void you will find happiness! Even if it slips free with the half-life of the chemicals. You can find it. You can have it. It exists out there. Here. The final night of thoughtless rest, however short it might be. You don't dream of waking up. You don't dream.By the time you reach the bottom, your heart is pounding. You feel almost like you're in the midst of some criminal act, a child stealing treats and hiding just barely out of sight. It is exhilarating! It is the most alive you've felt in... who knows how long. The world outside of you and your immediate challenges ceases to exist, and your life feels entirely in your hands. [[(Look around.)|(Look around the forest.)]]This place is otherworldly to the life you have so far lived. It feels terrifying, yet comforting, as though it is where you have always belonged. This might be the furthest away from another sapient being that you have ever been. <<include [[Forest options]]>><<acumenTalk "High">> This far from the botanical gardens is largely ignored by animal life. Fluffy sheep https://bsky.app/profile/fluffysheepart.bsky.social - they seem quite good with backgrounds.Here's my journal entry from my first experience: I went to a soup kitchen today. The volunteers were all decidedly middle class. All fancy dressed, with posh accents, cars, families. The ones I spoke to looked down on the homeless in some capacity. When I mentioned I'd spoke with someone called Michael about their last 20 years, my coworker's initial reaction was "Oh dear." Another repeatedly pointed out individuals in the queue - that one doesn't look like they're homeless - that one ignored my advice - that one spilled food on my nice white trousers (this is real). He also spoke ill of other volunteers who only appeared a few times. He seemed, overall, a very bitter man. One lady asked me for money. I, for the first time, said directly no and that I was uncomfortable with it. I am attempting to be more honest with strangers. One person asked for water, rather than tea or coffee. They did not have it. If I am consistently here, I will absolutely push for caffeine-free drinks - squash, is my choice. Caffeine at 19:30 is a terrible idea anyway. I started to understand the difficulty to helping someone to recovery, while speaking with many of the homeless. It seems obvious, but most people do not want to talk about their problems; they just want a pound so they can go buy a lagar. I'll now talk about Michael. Michael came to my attention by approaching with a bike, and asking specifically for vegetarian food. The staff were unprepared for this. As they floundered to search for a solution, I spoke with Michael. "Vegetarian? That must be difficult." It is. As we spoke, he told me of his last 20 years. He had left his last city, Glasgow, because one day, he woke up in a bathroom with a massive headache. He believed a friend had 'clipped' him. He accused each of his friends, and became deeply paranoid. Not even rumour stirred. He then has this happen again, possibly years later, in his home. He searched his whole house for a sign that someone had broken in, and found none. The headache persisted for days, so he went to the doctor. "You had a stroke." He was informed. It was his second one. He believes he has brain damage, but he showed no signs, to me. Michael spoke passionately on every topic, with ample humour and energy. When we spoke of veganism, he shared his views clearly, flavoured with a hypothetical about what aliens might think and do if they saw how we treat animals. Yet he did not seem to judge anyone who ate meat. Our discussion filled the hour, and I have left much out. I hope that will not matter, as I hope it will not be our last encounter.<<addSkill "heart" 2>>\ <span class="heartColor">++ Effusive Heart</span> <<addSkill "acumen" 1>>\ <span class="acumenColor">+ Plastic Acumen</span> There is so much guilt. Do you remember that relationship you ruined? Did you just ask yourself 'which one?' and 'whose?' That person you nearly drove to abandon life? The people you held so tight they choked? How often are you remembered by scars traced in the dead of night? How many have given up on you? How many have you run away from? It must be in the multi hundreds now! Who could ever forgive someone covered in so much gore? No matter how you wash, you are tainted. You don't deserve //love//. You don't deserve anything short of exactly what you're getting right now. You belong here. [[Continue|Home]]<<addSkill "heart" 1>>\ <span class="heartColor">+ Effusive Heart</span> <<addSkill "psyche" 2>>\ <span class="psycheColor">++ Indomitable Psyche</span> No one knows who you really are. No one wants to. No one cares what you do with your day, they're not interested in how you grew up, or what you hope for. No one is invested in what you make, or why. Nobody likes the books you like, or the art, or the songs, or the smells. They are not interested in what messages you get from your nightmares, of how the colours in the city make you cry, or the strange way you lock your hands together as comfort when you feel unsafe. There is no one to love you. No one to help you make a difference in the world. No one to challenge you when the dark overruns you. You gave everything for the person who did even a fraction of it. They're gone now. Nothing's left. All of these experiences and pains will leave with you, when you are obliterated. [[Continue|Home]]<<if $skillRanking == "acumen">>\ <<include [[Book is a comfort]]>> <<elseif $skillRanking == "heart">>\ <<include [[Feeds discussion]]>> <<else>>\ <<include [[Feel smart]]>> <</if>>\ <<include [[Home options]]>><<psycheTalk "">> You feel pretty smart carrying paper everywhere you go.<<acumenTalk "">> It's hard to resist carrying //something// around with you, even if you rarely get use from them. The option is a comfort.<<heartTalk "">> Sometimes, people notice the book hanging from your inner pocket. Sometimes, you show it. In both cases, it feeds a meaningful discussion.You're not sleeping. You're spiralling again. You can see it, but you can't stop it. You're trying desperately to fight back. But even as you know the thoughts aren't true, your feelings refuse to agree. God, this is all so pointless. Not just the thoughts, but trying to fight them. It's been years, you're still no better. This mind is shortcircuiting. Rotting. But where can you go? What else do you have? Every step upwards is more energy for the inevitable, predictable fall. You made so much progress last time. Is that why it hurts so much? You're biting the insides of your cheeks, again. Your digging your claws in, again. Stop it - it doesn't hurt, much, but enough repetition leaves marks. Come on, you're better than that, surely. If only you could rest. Just for a few days! Somewhere you don't need to fear yourself. You're so, so very tired. Tired. Alone. Hopeless. Scared. Hurt. [[Continue|Pointless feelings]]You'll probably survive the night, I guess. Think of it statistically: you've survived 100% of the time so far. You're good at seeing yourself as a statistic. Knowing it will end, probably by tomorrow, almost makes it worse. If it's going to end, why can't it end now!? The feelings start to feel like a mimed performance. A procedure with nothing to say, rehearsed, and pointless. Finally, you are face down. You have been, slightly, suffocating. Perhaps it helped, as you are at least worn out, now. You return to your back, return your gaze to the ceiling. But you are still, very, uncomfortable. You roll over. <<endRun "Sleepless">>Pinned to the monuments are an uncountable number of portraits. Some, photographs. Some sketches onto paper, many less professional than others. The mass graves are symbolic. They are a cultural staple, a political statement against the east. You too, will be here. If you are remembered. The only way out of here for a body is the chimney smoke, and to select few, the ice. The smiles surround you in every direction. Most are reserved, simple, nice. Did they know this would be their final memory? <<if $acumen >= 1>>\ <<include [[They are depicted happy]]>> <</if>>\ <<if $psyche >= 3>>\ <<include [[You should be remembered]]>> <</if>>\ <<if $heart < 3>>\ <<include [[Cannot comprehend the dead]]>> <<else>>\ <<include [[Talk to the dead]]>> <</if>>\ <<include [[Graveyard options]]>><<set $deadBirdWhat to false>>\ <<set $deadBirdApologize to false>>\ <<set $deadBirdWho to false>>\ The picture is flaking from age, and is the final of its kind. You do not know how to tell the sex of this species. Perhaps they did not have one, you've heard that somewhere. Your father, maybe. The words aren't yours to speak. The meanings shared are pushed and pulled like tides in your mind. <<include [[Dead bird options]]>>'God decided it so; we were no more. In His new world, He selected the best. Our kind, we were like wind through woods. Our hearts were the sunny shimmer at the edge of a cloud. The woods are gone. The clouds have no edge. We are gone, taken slow by a plague of the air. Forgotten. Our history is erased. Our secrets are safe. You are loved. You are loved! Rejoice, for He loves you! And now, He has more room to love you, and you alone.' <<include [[Dead bird options]]>>'Yes, I am too! How I would love to dance and sing and flutter at your side. But it was not to be so. What place does this world have for us, this new world of chains and cages? What do our brittle forms do now? We were but a sentinel species. Thank His plague, for it has allowed you knowledge, and so, time. We will be together again, worry not.' <<include [[Dead bird options]]>>'Who was I not! Life savoured sweetly on the beak, brevity and certainty the fuel of boundless meaning. You were kind! I mapped the stars, you showed me God, I saw the future, we lived the past, I defeated and was defeated. When my time had come, so had my calling. The calling from above, from the skies, still there! I took flight, upwards and eastwards, to the rising of God, the final dove in the last flood, my olive branch never to return.' <<include [[Dead bird options]]>><<set $deadRodentWhy to false>>\ <<set $deadRodentKnow to false>>\ <<set $deadRodentUnderstand to false>>\ They don't look dead. They look at you with a smile you cannot turn away from. It seems to melt your insecurities. Of all of them, they seem the most alive - why is that? Your eyes keep wandering to their photo. You can't believe that they're here! You take it down. You hold it. The photo is recent, and seems impossible - they can't be in there. That one is alive! You are adamant about it. More than any others, you can see it moving. <<include [[Dead rodent options]]>>They laugh, genuinely. What a statement, they think! 'Because you're here, ya goof. You brought me here. And I appreciate that!' You can feel their whiskers twitching as they happily brux at you. That is weird. You almost want them to stop. But the sight makes you happy, too. 'Uh, sorry. Or, no, I don't mean sorry. Bwah, you know. But uh... you know I'm not. I know I'm not. It's why you're here. That means something to you, doesn't it?' <<include [[Dead rodent options]]>>'I really hope not, because that means I forgot you. I wouldn't want that. I can see who you are, and you're... ah, well. You know!' You don't know. 'No, come on. You do, right? That's not, normal. None of this is normal, I don't know if you were ever normal. And that's what I like. That's what we need more of, really... even if it's hard.' <<include [[Dead rodent options]]>>'I do... Even second hand, it's agony to hear. I'm so sorry. I wish I... Augh, I'm sorry, I'm making it about me.' Please. Make it about you. Not about us. 'But I'm not the one who needs it, am I?' No... 'Please. Look after yourself. You don't know how much is still left.' <<include [[Dead rodent options]]>>You can't keep this up. They understand, more truly than anyone else. <<include [[Talk to the dead options]]>><<set $deadFluffyImportant to false>>\ <<set $deadFluffyWhat to false>>\ <<set $deadFluffyRegret to false>>\ It is one of the first depictions on one of the oldest mouments. It is sketched, rather elegantly, using long expressive strokes to exaggerate the breadth of its coat. <<include [[Dead fluffy options]]>>Another piece flakes off, and flutters gracefully to the stone floor below. You will try to remember. <<include [[Talk to the dead options]]>>'They found us, naturally! What can you do to argue with the sharpened tip of a pick, and a head that won't think? I'll spare you in particular the intricacies. History would struggle to repeat itself at this point but, well it can undoubtedly rhyme. I would think you'll be rather familiar before long!' <<include [[Dead fluffy options]]>>'Oh yes, once! But we are all rather quite equal at this stage, aren't we? Well, I would have thought so, I think they would disagree.' You know who //they// are. 'I was with the first, of course. The pogrom pushed me here. I had been the owner of Stars, United! in my prior engagement. What a target I was! I rather thought I'd had enough. Thought we all had, seeing it happen. Apparently that was just the beginning for some.' <<include [[Dead fluffy options]]>>'I can't say that I do. Statistically, it was over before I had even begun. Should we do nothing, and wait for certain doom to come to us? Or should we act on the remote odds that some may survive, at the cost of all? And what if the Extra-Normality were proven true? At least we would have gone gently. Of course, they wouldn't understand that. They see the tourists, and they see frivolity. I am certain we were doomed nonetheless. I am certain I have done great things.' <<include [[Dead fluffy options]]>>If nothing else, the art //is// beautiful. <<include [[Talk to the dead options]]>><<heartTalk "Extreme">> There is a kindness in their faces that the living never know.
