Heart sees a depiction of their many sufferings - the work, the air, the living conditions, the societal conditions.You spit on your hand, and shine one of the newest monuments, seeing yourself as best you can in the reflection. It's not much more than a silhouette, but you can work with this. You sketch the outline, fill its features. No one will mind if you exaggerate the shine in your eye a little, or the power stored in your shoulders. Your smile is a little smug. You know what you know, and they'll know that you know what you know now. [[Continue|Pin your work]]Proudly, you sign your work. You move one of the other photos out of the way, so that yours can be right in the center at eye level. Excellent work. This action will surely never be forgotten. <<include [[Graveyard options]]>>[[Sit for a while, and think.]] <<if $heart >= 3>>\ <<include [[Talk to the dead options]]>> <</if>>\ <<if $psyche >= 2>>\ [[(Sketch your face in your notebook, attach it to a monument.)]] <</if>>\<<psycheTalk "High">> You deserve to be remembered. You haven't been forgotten yet, but what's the harm in getting ahead?<<addSkill "heart" 1>>\ <span class="heartColor">+ Effusive Heart</span> <<addSkill "acumen" 2>>\ <span class="acumenColor">++ Plastic Acumen</span> The less of your emotions you let them see, the longer they stay. Your unending list of failures gives you a lot of experience to pull on, many stories to weave, and if you keep them strictly told by a dispassionate storyteller when they need it most, you become helpful and wise. Once they see how fundamentally damaged and dysfunctional you are, your words lose any weight. Some people just aren't made for this. You think of the tales of people stranded for years with no contact, of people ostracized since birth, and how they learned to live without another soul around. Maybe that's the life you should identify with. Someday you might get used to it. You always said that so long as one person wants you around, you will be around. Once more: who do you have, now? [[Continue|Home]]<<addSkill "heart" 2>>\ <span class="heartColor">++ Effusive Heart</span> <<addSkill "psyche" 1>>\ <span class="psycheColor">+ Indomitable Psyche</span> They could never give what you gave to them. That is to say, you are far too much for anyone to handle. You do not know how to control yourself, and you keep hoping someone else will figure it out for you. They won't. You are a tumour. Everything gets on so smoothly without you. You interrupt people's best moments with the same problems you've had for years. Do you ever change? Your best wouldn't even measure up to a fraction of what they are. It seemed best to cut yourself out. Maybe it'll kill you. Maybe you'll find somewhere you finally belong. Maybe they aren't so different. [[Continue|Home]]<<addSkill "heart" 3>>\ <span class="heartColor">+++ Effusive Heart</span> They're living their lives, happily. Finding new friends, falling in love, succeeding, moving on. Moving on from you. You'll get in their way. Drag them down with you. No one //wants// you around, and you don't deserve to have them around. An out of work, substance abusing dead-end nobody. Unable to smile, unable to forget, stuck in a death spiral, habitually alone. No one wants that. No one wants you. Just stay out of their way. [[Continue|Home]]<<addSkill "acumen" 3>>\ <span class="acumenColor">+++ Plastic Acumen</span> They don't know the true you, despite all of your warnings. The depths you are //truly// capable of. You can be brutally manipulative, a disgusting, despicable, deplorable person, devoid of the most basic empathies. It was an important skill to master to survive your youth. You struggle to trust that anything you do is sincere - are even these thoughts insincere? A play put on to attract pity, unaware that nobody is watching, and nobody cares. And then there is us. There is not a soul left who deserves the fate of seeing us. Except, of course, for you. [[Continue|Home]]<<addSkill "acumen" 2>>\ <<addSkill "psyche" 1>>\ <span class="acumenColor">++ Plastic Acumen</span> <span class="psycheColor">+ Indomitable Psyche</span> You have been disappointed more than you can remember. The betrayals have started to become predictable. The common passage from friend, to crush, to implicit enemy you have been subject to. The lies they did not realize they were telling. How can you ever understand what's going on in their mind? Do they understand it? Are they all acutely aware of exactly how they act? Or are they totally oblivious, don't put a single thought into what they've done? Which is worse? You are done. No one will crack this shell. There is only one person left to trust: You. The one who never changes. Can never change. [[Continue|Home]]The envelope's wax seal is marked with the unique dermal ridge pattern of a lutrine, the name "Coal" is scribbled below. A smile is drawn in the corner. The wax has not been disturbed. <<if $psyche <= 1>>\ <<include [[Too late]]>> <</if>>\ [[Open it.|Open Coal's letter]] <<if $psyche <= 1>>\ [[Don't open it.|Ignore Coal's letter]] <</if>>\<<psycheTalk "High">> Here was someone who understood your drive. How many new things has he picked up since you last spoke? The two of you were a machine of perpetual motivation, bouncing ideas and support like a house of mirrors, complementing talents with skills to achieve anything. This very desk is one such product. Creation hasn't been the same without him. You've been too tense. You want to remember him. <<psycheTalk "Extreme">> Coal's so good with his hands. Not to mention, hot. If nothing else, a great reason to respond is that you could finally fuck, with a little persistence. The travel would be well worth it. It's obvious he wants you.<<psycheTalk "Low">> Coal is a better person than you. He's some, paragon of perfection, the best at everything. Everyone loves him, nothing stops him. Nothing you could ever do would make you even a fraction of who he is. These letters are a constant and oppressive reminder of that. You wish he would just give up on you.You have been sitting in front of an almost blank page for an unreasonable amount of time, the only markings being sentences cut short and reduced to a smear. Your insides twist around each other, will not resolve. The lock refuses to turn; things just, aren't quite right in your mind. There's no denying his art is nice, at least. It peeks through the shroud over your mind. [[(Display the artwork.)|Pin art to the wall]]<!-- Since getting to this uses all 4 skill points, and thus the library point, this isn't strictly necessary. But, for safety. -->\ <<set $homeTimePassed to $homeTimePassed + 1>>\ 'Hey Coal. I'm not doing good. Actually, this is the worst I've ever been. So much has gone wrong, so quickly. You know how moody I could be at the best of times, could you believe what it's like at the worst of times? I'm a tempest. I could fill an entire book just talking about it. In fact, I have been. I'm sure you've picked up a thousand talents since I saw you. I've picked up writing, and it's... coming along. Good, maybe, I go back and forth on that opinion. Most of the time I'm just writing it because I need to. The rest of the time, I'm thinking of what you might say when I show you. I miss you. Not in a, I'm trying to guilt you back kind of way. I get it. A butterfly flapped its wings, and the world was never the same again. I regularly wonder, what would Coal do? What advice would Coal give? You gave me so much when you were here. My life is better because you were in it. I think about you a lot, way more than my silence would betray. It's hard to make myself talk to anyone. That I can even write back to you is a miracle. Thousands of thoughts went into this action. If you're reading this, I was able to overcome them this time. As I write, I know today will matter. Something is changing. I hope some day I will visit you, finished book under my arm, and tell you how I solved it all. How's Upper 13 been treating you? You get around to trying the clubs? I hope it's been all you wanted it to be. This letter of yours, it matters to me. It all mattered to me. Your art was beautiful. It will be on my wall as long as I last. I love you, Coal. Platonically, et al.' [[Continue|Keep letter]]<<heartTalk "Low">> What could you even begin to say? You've kept quiet for so long it feels like you could never start again. So many words swirl through your mind when you try to put ink to paper. Come back, I need you; I'm not me anymore, please forget that person; how could you do this to me; I'm being tortured, I'm not going to make it. And then there's that, damn sign off... You can't say any of it. It isn't right. That's not what he deserves. It won't fix you. You can't be fixed this time.<<if $openingCommentIndex == 0>>\ <<include [[You'll give up]]>> <<elseif $openingCommentIndex == 1>>\ <<include [[Been here before]]>> <<elseif $openingCommentIndex == 2>>\ <<include [[Memory of a friend]]>> <<set $specialOpening to true>>\ <<elseif $openingCommentIndex == 3>>\ <<include [[Farewell to lost friend]]>> <<elseif $openingCommentIndex == 4>>\ <<include [[Not today.]]>> <<set $specialOpening to true>>\ <<elseif $openingCommentIndex == 5>>\ <<include [[This is your life]]>> <<elseif $openingCommentIndex == 6>>\ <<include [[Leave form behind]]>> <<elseif $openingCommentIndex == 7>>\ <<include [[A good day]]>> <<set $specialOpening to true>>\ <<elseif $openingCommentIndex == 8>>\ <<include [[How many times]]>> <<elseif $openingCommentIndex == 9>>\ <<include [[Starting to get bored]]>> <</if>>\<<set $hasLetterForCoal to true>>\ You'll keep it on you for a while. You'll try to work up the courage to post it, some time. In your wave of uncharacteristic action, you almost forget to pin Coal's art to your wall. This will remain, as a potent symbol of who you are. <<getDialogueOptions "Home options">>\You pin it to the wall. Maybe, someday, he'll see it, and he'll understand. You throw your failed letter into the mountain with the other scraps. <<getDialogueOptions "Home options">>\<<set $homeTimePassed to $homeTimePassed + 1>>\ 'Heya. It's been a while. How are you doing? Good, I hope. I got the !quality wax! Been thinking of you. The chimney's treating me well. It's warm. I changed careers, again. Maybe if I stick to this one it'll be worth telling you about. Let's just say, it uses my body in a ~special way~. A fun way! Do you remember day one? It's like that. There's so many jobs, all the time! They barely care if you're qualified. I hear it's stricter on the higher rings. This place suits me fine. It gets lonely. Not much to talk about when you can't mention the last 30 years, eh? They're nice enough. They don't mean harm. But they aren't family. I put some money in the envelope, for the border fee. Say hi back, would ya? Love ya, platonically et al.' At the bottom of the envelope is far more money than the postage fee. [[(Turn the page over.)|Look at Coal's art]]There's a charcoal sketch at the back of the page. It feels smooth, has a faint shine and flora smell from whatever fixative he used. It's you, laying on a bed with a guitar flat over your chest. Little traditional music notes are floating up. They make no sense, but he is not a musician. As best you can tell in the art style, you seem relaxed, possibly happy. Sitting at your feet, Coal is looking longingly into the distance. You miss him so much. [[What would I say?]] <<if $acumen < 1>>\ There was no one like Coal. He took a part of you with him. Each reminder of him is another session wondering what could've been. Both of you are keeping old memories on life support, <<elseif $acumen == 1>>\ <<include [[Coal can be trusted]]>> <<else>>\ <<include [[Coal is valuable]]>> <</if>>\ <<if $psyche < 2>>\ <<include [[Coal isn't actually interested]]>> <<elseif $psyche == 2>>\ <<include [[Coal understood you]]>> <<else>>\ <<include [[Coal was hot]]>> <</if>>\ <<if $heart >= 1 && $acumen >= 1 && $psyche >= 2>>\ [[(Try to respond.)|Write letter successfully]] <<else>>\ [[(Try to respond.)|Fail to write response]] <</if>>\No matter what you do, you end up back here. Eventually, when you realize it never changes, you will give up.You've been here before. This is not a story of happy endings. Whether you ignore the impulses or not, they are still here. They are a part of you, and your story. They have happened, and they will keep happening, even if today is an exception. It's only a matter of time.Why do you keep doing this? Is it some yelp for help? What's with all the... flair? You wouldn't advise this to anyone, you know better. You just don't act better. Maybe this is just a fond farewell to a lost friend. You'd really hate to admit that.You lay here, thinking about how often you lay here, thinking. You wonder if maybe, this is your life. If there's no "normal" to get back to, and your time spent doing anything else is the weird part.You keep hoping one of these mornings your body will have failed. You'll try to get up, and you'll find that you leave your corporeal form behind, and you'll see them peacefully resting for the last time.How many times have you been through this? At least <<print GetPlayCount()>>, by this point. That you remember. Yet you keep ending up no better than you started.You're starting to get bored of doing this over and over by now. You wish you could just get up and walk away from it all, experience some new life with new flavours. But there is nowhere to walk to. You have done this hundreds of times over the years. There's no reason to think it will ever stop.<<if $lastEndingType == "Rigid">>\ <<include [[Awoken rigid]]>>\ <<elseif $lastEndingType == "Comfortable">>\ <<include [[Comfortable, interwoven]]>>\ <<elseif $lastEndingType == "Panicked">>\ <<include [[A terrified start]]>>\ <<elseif $lastEndingType == "Dead">>\ <<include [[Dead start]]>>\ <<elseif $lastEndingType == "Hiding">>\ <<include [[Hidden away]]>>\ <<elseif $lastEndingType == "Exhausted">>\ <<include [[In the act]]>>\ <<elseif $lastEndingType == "Atypical">>\ <<include [[Inverted]]>>\ <<elseif $lastEndingType == "Sleepless">>\ <<include [[Sleepless]]>>\ <<elseif $lastEndingType == "Trapped">>\ <<include [[Trapped]]>>\ <</if>>\You awake rigid, staring at the ceiling. Your body does not feel that it has moved at all from last night - an anomaly. Your blanket is overtop you, in an entirely clinical and uninteresting way. Your pillow is flat below you. This isn't comfortable, but it let you sleep, so that counts for something.Your body is interwoven with your blanket, wrapping over and slipping between legs, spiralling around back, held in arms and pressed to cheek. It will be a while till you escape.You awake with a gasp, a cold sweat, panic pulsing through your body. You can feel your heart in every vein, pounding triple digits every minute. It takes an instant stretched to eternity to be certain you are not currently in danger.You are flat on your back on the floor. Your mouth is agape, your tongue is dry. It feels as though you have been resurrected. Your breath is shallow, your heart is silent, at first. They are winding up.Today you are under your bed. It is tight, you can barely move, you cannot take a deep breath. The light creeping into your hiding spot signals the start of your day. You won't face it for a while longer.You wake up to the sound of a groan. It is yours. Your face is covered in drool. It is also yours. From the signals running through your body, you can deduce that you laying with your cheek to your desk, your arms sprawled ahead of you, slumped over in your chair. It looks miserable. It doesn't feel much better.Your legs are on your bed. Not much else is. You can feel the pulse of every heartbeat through your head, which lays on the floor a ways below. It's oddly comfortable, in the same way general anesthesia and surgery is oddly comfortable. If your blood pressure were checked right now, it might read impossible digits.<<psycheTalk "Low">> Meh. I don't know that's true. <<include [[Step outside]]>>- Houses on a slope - Rock roof - Furries - Diverse races - Unrecognized faces - unfamiliar with neighboursThe graveyard is one of the few attractions in the industrial district. It is the only one, anywhere, as far as you know. The escapees needed it; they had nothing, but their loss. [[Continue|Mass grave monuments]]- There is a plaque dedicated to all those lost in the Cryogenium. - What does the shadow of death make you feel?You can see Rey here hanging out with Molen. Joining them from this point gives you a worse starting point on the nightOutMood.You toss it into the pile of other unattended thoughts and actions. Crisis averted. <<getDialogueOptions "Home options">>\<<psycheTalk "Low">> You've avoided opening it for this long. Whatever's inside, it's too late for you to deal with at this point. It's better to not know.<<acumenTalk "Medium">> 'et al.' You two would never risk it. But it was impossible to lie. There is so much left unsaid in his letter. So much left unsaid since he left - actually, you haven't said anything. He doesn't know who you are any more, after all that's happened. You've known him long enough to detect the hint of insecurity, the humour hiding honesty. You've not been good to him. You're bitter, but he deserves better. You have too much history to forget. He will accept you, he can be trusted, and he deserves to be.It doesn't feel like you woke up. It feels like you were always awake, and you have just now chosen to open your eyes. The last however many hours are a blur of thoughts and feelings dumped into short term memory and promptly forgotten, only the lingering of their destruction left behind.But it was you lost him. It was- is, very difficult. There has been no one to fit the shape left in your life. Perhaps, you are more hole than person, by now.There is an entire city before you, and yet there is little you can imagine catching your interest. Nonetheless, you stand, stare at the buildings ahead of you, and think. <<if $heart <= 0>>\ <</if>>\ <<if $psyche <= 0>>\ <<psycheTalk "Low">> Todays agenda: go back to sleep. <<if $psyche <= 0>>\ <<elseif $psyche == 2>>\ <<psycheTalk "High">> I think we're all missing a very obvious cause to our problems. <<elseif $psyche >= 3>>\ <<psycheTalk "Extreme">> Excuse me everybody, shut up. I have something vitally important to ask. <</if>>\ <<if $psyche >= 2>> [[(Listen to the question.)|Last Laid]] <</if>>\Rey had a twin who died a few years ago. She left their family before the incident with Rey."'Course! I get it. It's not often people tell you what they see." He touches your shoulder lightly, before returning to the bed. <<include "Visit Rey options">><<if $psyche <= 0>>\ <<psycheTalk "Low">> On second thought, I think it's best we turn and run away right now. <</if>>\<!-- TODO: Add some more variants to this, as the player will see it a lot. -->\ You have grown restless in this prison. You stand eyeing the door for a moment, before impulse pushes you forward. Nothing new has happened in here for as long as you can remember. Maybe, the outside world will have something of worth today. You don't want to go outside today. But you told yourself that you would yesterday. You make a pact with yourself: if it goes poorly, you don't have to do it again. Just this once. You try to imagine what lies outside of your house. What could possibly be so good as to dedicate your entire day to, when you could instead pass it here, where you know exactly what awaits you? You can't think of any answers, good or bad. There seems to be nothing at all out there. You should go outside. You're running out of food, despite your rationing. You're thinking back to the time you ran through the streets, and nearly barrelled into some passer-by. The thought that someone, anyone might recognize you from this is too much to bear. You're standing at the door. Staring at it. After a moment, you lean against it. The cold of the metal handle is nice. Nice enough to stay. Could you imagine how you might react if you saw them while out? You can, you do each time, and even that is an understatement. It's a big risk to take. For what gain? Some nebulous concept of opportunity? <<if $psyche <= 0>>\ [[Continue|Outside is too much.]] <<else>>\ [[Continue|Step outside]] <</if>>\<<acumenTalk "High">> Coal is someone of great value. Talented, connected, experienced. He saved you once, he can do it again."What?" His question is final, the 't' enunciated sharp enough to cut the air. The world is silent. You feel as if your breath were ripped from your lungs. He is glaring at you. What do you say? What can you say? "[[Uh...|Rey upset with joke]]"He sits there. Waiting. [[...|Say nothing to Rey]]"And- AND THAT'S ALL YOU HAVE TO SAY?" You've never heard him yell. It doesn't sound right. He is at his feet, fists clenched. His whole body vibrates. He is waiting again. [[...|Continue silence to Rey]]"Ugh..." He takes long breath. When he releases it, his voice isn't the same. Every word has returned to being gentle, and kind. "I'm sorry too. That was really unreasonable of me. I just, that term in particular... Gah, we're both stupid, hah." [[Continue|How have I been?]]"It's a lot of small things, mostly. Some big things. I guess, the most obvious one right now is, you. I've been worried. A lot." "I've seen you change over the years, but you always had the same core to you. That boundless, optimistic drive to help everyone. That passion for new experiences... You were always trying to understand yourself and the world around you. No matter how hard you were knocked down, you would always get back up." His head is tilted to the side with a faint smile. He's looking through you, at the memories. "You were inspirational..." [[Continue|Rey was worried]]"You left your job. You stopped talking to people. You were thinner every time I saw you, which wasn't often. You were just... withering. You were the one person who never gave up. And you were defeated." "I didn't know what to do. I'm not equipped for that, I don't... I don't know your pain. I can never know your pain. I just pretended to be okay so I wouldn't become a part of your suffering... and I... now I'm... I just made it worse..." His head is bowed down, his breath is staccato. In the quiet between them, the soft thumps of tears can be heard below his face. "I'm so sorry I didn't do more. I couldn't bare to watch someone I love so much die." "[[You did what you could. No one person should bear the whole burden of someone else's life. What you've done has been important for me.|My burden]]" "[[I'm not fixed. This talk was good- great for me. It's a perspective I needed. There will be bad days in the future. But I'm still in here. I'm still trying.|Not fixed]]" "[[I don't know who I am, who I was, or who I'll become. Who I used to be couldn't survive this life. I'm trying to find a version of me who can be happy.|Being reborn]]" "[[I am in a lot of pain. I don't know how I'll progress. Sometimes it's okay, sometimes it's terrible. I hope I'm getting better. For now, I'm happy, and I want to enjoy that.|I am in pain]]""You're, sweet..." A bittersweet smile. His tears do not stop. [[(Sit by Rey.)|Sit beside Rey]]"After all of this? Do you even care?!" He waits. [[...|Do you care?]] None of this happened to //you// though. You're an observer to this life, a curious alien who has tuned in to the most worthless channel out of mobid curiosity. There's nothing you can do to change how this goes, and you don't care to. See how it sits in bed and does nothing after that. Nothing? Surely not, it just lost everything. No, really! It ''is'' doing nothing! What's even going on inside of it, anything? It's probably best to just leave it to rot. There's nothing you can do for some, thing, like this. It isn't worth the effort. [[Continue|Shutting down]]Seems it is shutting down, now. It has achieved its goal of maximizing misery, and it feels nothing. Well, that was boring, wasn't it? <<endRun "Rigid">><<psycheTalk "Extreme">> He's good enough. You would.<<heartTalk "Low">> Phew, you got off lucky here.On the left side of his neck, there is a scar forging its way through his short fur, disappearing below the neckline of his shirt. The surrounding fur is brushed in a particular way to try, with decent success, to obscure it. <<if $acumen >= 1>>\ <<include [[Medium scar analysis]]>> <</if>>\ <<if $acumen >= 2>>\ <<include [[High scar analysis]]>> <</if>>\ <<if $heart >= 2>>\ <<include [[Busy mind]]>> <</if>>\ <<if $psyche >= 3>>\ <<include [[You would]]>> <</if>>\For as long as you've known him, he's never dressed as you would expect. His bright colours and patterns stand out among the sincere and plain coats of his colleagues. Today, he is in a black button up shirt with pink floral patterning, a loose and unbuttoned dark purple cardigan flowing down his sides, and airy burgundy trousers. He stands out against the dark oranges, reds and purples of his room. At his hip is an elaborate cloth pouch embroidered with a palette of warm colours on black, corners tipped with tassels that end in tiny beads. It appears to be empty today. <<include [[Consider joke]]>><<if $heart <= 1>>\ <<heartTalk "Low">> He's pretty nice. Very helpful and funny."So you disappear for weeks without a word, you cut everyone off, you barely pay any attention to what anyone else is going through, and then you show up out of nowhere and start calling me slurs?" He laughs, a mixture of nervousness and anger overflowing. "And I'm just supposed to accept that and keep happy for you? What do you think all of that does to someone?" This is a delicate situation. There is a right way to handle this, think... [[Continue|Handling the situation]]At the budding of a new perspective on the world, you clamp your claws into your arm. Think about the texture of pain, how it echoes in your mind when you let up. You repeat often, adjusting intensity as needed. You don't want anything. You don't feel anything. Repeat it. Repeat it. You feel absolutely, completely, normal. Nothing is wrong. Nothing is wrong. Something's taking over. You're not ready. It's okay. You're okay. The pounding of your heart has taken over your mind, and decorated your coat taboo. A moment to breathe, shake, sigh. You are not better than this. [[Continue|Home]]<<psycheTalk "Low">> Here it comes. Finally. It was inevitable. You //do// deserve this, and he deserves revenge. He has some great reasons to hate you, and the least you can do is take ownership of how terrible you have been. Give him the closure you don't have. "[[Yeah. You're right. I'm a pretty shit person.|I'm a shit person]]"<<acumenTalk "Low">> Oh no, he knows. He's seen through you. It's happening - it's happening again. You need to get out of here right now. He is going to kill you with his words. Go, go and, you need to leave. No, it's too late, you need to fight - he's going to destroy you, this will escape, you must contain it. Fight back. You need to defend yourself. You have no more ground to give, you can't allow this to happen again. "[[There it is! This is who you really are.|Just like them]]"<<heartTalk "Low">> What happened? What did you do? Why is he acting like this? Why do you feel like this? What can you do, is it too late? It's too late, but what can do you? He's being so unreasonable - but why? This isn't who he is. You've known him for years, this isn't him. There's a mistake here. He's forgotten who you are. He forgot. No- he- you love him. He must know that. How could he ever think otherwise? How - how could this happen? Why can't you understand who he is? You're doing awful, and he's doing this to you. How, could he "[[]]"<<heartTalk "Medium">> He's completely right to be angry with all of this. The slur, that was stupid but it isn't the cause of his outburst. He's really upset, about a lot of things. He needs an outlet. You can make this better. "[[Rey, I'm sorry. It was a dumb joke, I didn't mean for it to hurt. But you're right, I haven't been good to you. So, how have you been?|How is Rey?]]"Oh... This... is a terrible misunderstanding. You could not have known, but you have made a grave mistake. You need to own up to it, be honest.You don't know what it does to people. You didn't think about that, and it's to late to now. All you can do is try to do better in the future. Starting now.The sweetness of their voice, the softness of their touch, the happiness, hopes and plans, schemes and dreams. You danced because you could not keep still! You were someone new, someone unrecognizable, someone everyone wanted you to be, everything had been leading up to this and it was perfect, there was nothing you would change, nothing you could change, nothing you could do, you were enthralled, you were defenceless, you hadn't noticed had you, it was so subtle, so quiet and kind, it was fate, it was fatal. You choke, invisibly, again. It stops. Twice. What could you have done? Make sure it can't repeat.You can't stop yourself anymore. "You're just like <<exName>>. You delude yourself into thinking you're better than everyone else. You're no different." "Wow! Okay?!" He looks around in astonishment, taking in his surroundings to be sure this is actually happening. "It's no wonder they left, you're unhinged! I spent, so long..." His breath escapes him. "I..." Again. <<acumenTalk "Low">> He has gone too far, and he paid the price. You both have. The debt is racking up. You are emotionally, morally, bankrupt. [[Continue|You've done enough]]"... Just, fucking, get out, please." You do, unceremoniously. <<psycheTalk "Low">> He's right, you know. They all were. You've gone too far, this time. No coming back. The best you can do is let it happen. You'll miss him. But you didn't deserve him in the first place. You're a shit person, this keeps happening, and now you've proven it: the one person who never gave up on you, has given up. What does that say? You're hopeless. [[Continue|Dissociation]]He's breathing heavily. He's holding onto the back of a chair. He looks away, and it's clear he's crying. You've done enough. You don't say anything as you leave. He doesn't look. [[Continue|Escape Rey]]The world is moving. You are making it, but still they follow. Your surroundings are unfamiliar, you haven't seen a new face in a while but it's still too recent. Around you the world seems to collapse, you can't breathe, there's nothing ahead of you anymore but you are still moving, they'll catch up if you stop, and you'll wish you were dead. [[Keep running.|Your legs scream]]Your legs are screaming, you can't breathe, you consider screaming but just yell somewhat loudly, you just can't breathe, the pain in your feet is too much to keep running, so you clamp your teeth into your shoulder until you taste iron so that you can keep running, you have to keep running, if you go far enough you'll be free, you can see your heart pounding in your vision and you can't breathe no matter how hard you work your lungs. [[Collapse.|Your spirit gives out]]Your spirit gives out and you're on the floor, it's almost here, you can feel it mounting you, you can feel the wound pouring, cooling your limb and you consider another but don't have the energy anymore, you're weak, defenceless, you wonder how much more you need to push yourself until your heart stops, you wonder how long it would take to dehydrate but it isn't quick enough, it has you, it's too late. [[Give up.|You can't breathe]]<<set $lastEndingType to "Panicked">>\ You're curled up. Your heart is slowing. The blood is rolling down past your face, and it reminds you that you are real. This is real, and it's only the beginning. You collapse into yourself further. You can't breathe. The world is gone. The rock floor biting into your side, the pulsing of your shoulder, and the sobbing are the only things left. You try to speak to yourself but it's impossible. This is it. You have nothing left. Every gram of your mind shifted for one purpose. Torture.<!-- TODO: This could be an outcome for having a poor day out with Rey. Having a good day with him should be a very difficult route, as a result, both to reflect the difficulty of it in this state of mind, and to funnel people towards this route with more endings. -->\ <!-- Check if lowest skill is 0 or below -->\ <<if $skills.get($skillRanking[2]) <= 0>>\ <!-- Get lowest skill -->\ <<if $skillRanking[2] == "psyche">>\ <<include [[Masochistic reaction]]>> <<elseif $skillRanking[2] == "acumen">>\ <<include [[Fight or flight]]>> <<elseif $skillRanking[2] == "heart">>\ <<include [[Damaged]]>> <</if>>\ <<else>>\ <!-- Get highest skill -->\ <<if $skillRanking[0] == "heart">>\ <<include [[It's not about the slur]]>> <<elseif $skillRanking[0] == "acumen">>\ <<include [[It's a misunderstanding]]>> <<elseif $skillRanking[0] == "psyche">>\ <<include [[Try to be better]]>> <</if>>\ <</if>>\"Uh, how have I been?... I dunno. I've been working. A lot. I'm... overall, everything is okay in my life? Really, I should feel okay. I guess, seeing you again reminded me I'm not." You're really not sure how to take that. It doesn't matter. He isn't careful with his words right now, this isn't for you. "[[How so?]]"He leans his head on your shoulder. You take the hint and wrap an arm around beside him in a light hug. [[]]For now, you're relaxed here in bliss, legs over the edge, back against the ground. You're grinning through tears at the crystals above which shimmer at the luminous forest below. They remind you of <<exName>>, and you feel the breeze of untainted love roll free from you. [[I hope they got something from me. I hope they'll be happy.|I hope they'll be happy]]"I can't imagine it. But I couldn't imagine most of this. I'd suppose I don't have much control over it. The best I can do is "It wouldn't be a dramatic twist if we knew who would win, would it? You can't remember a single role you was suited for.<<if $psyche >= 3>>\ <<include [[Consider the weapon]]>> <</if>>\ <<if $psyche >= 3>>\ [[(Steal his weapon.)]] <</if>>\<<psycheTalk "Extreme">> He isn't looking. You can take his knife. You could become a hero. You could stop what they're doing. Your life could have meaning for once. You can picture it: the small one, then the big one, then this guy who no longer has any defence. You can do it.Deftly, you pull the blade from behind him. The sheath cries satisfyingly, draws the attention of everyone immediately. They are all watching you, knife in hand. [[Continue|They respond]]Time starts once more at the command of the beast. "RIGHT!" yells the little creature. It squeaks at this volume, yet still demands attention. "Okay, let's talk for a moment, shall we? This has gotten out of hand." You do not say anything. It's hard to say what you're thinking at all. "What is your goal here? We do not want bloodshed." "[[I just, really hate you people.]]" "[[To be honest, I hate myself! I, figure this isn't a bad way out!|Not a bad way out]]""This is not a productive outlet for that! Do you know what happens if I were to be harmed? A war. A war where everyone you know will die. I do not want that." <<heartTalk "Low">> Sure he doesn't. "Now, we are being reasonable. You are going to put that weapon down, or you will be killed immediately, for everyone's sake." [[(Attack.)]]"I see..." He seems genuinely saddened by this. "Come now. This isn't how it has to go for anyone. Put it down. There is a lot at stake. I can help you." <<acumenTalk "Low">> No... He's playing you. There's no possibility someone like //this// has kindness when you haven't found it in anyone else. [[(Attack.)]] [[(Drop the weapon.)]]Within the second you have been tackled to the floor. You can't breathe - you're being choked. "Let off! Get off, Brutus!" Your vision starts to return. You cough. "Look. I don't know what that was about, but I believe what you said. To be direct, you're scrawny, and this wasn't very well planned. You don't kill people. Something is just seriously wrong with you. Now, I could patter around you for the whole week trying to psychoanalyse what that could possibly be, but from this, I suspect even you don't know." [[Continue|You are a prisoner]]You take a step forward. Your heart lurches, coming to a realization of what this would really mean. You can't... kill. No, that's not who you are. Suddenly, you feel weak. You try to yell, but only a pitiful whimper comes out. [[Continue|Floored]]"Officially, I am taking you as a prisoner." He looks around and raises his voice. "Now, nobody saw what happened!!" Onlookers look away. After a pause, he continues. "If they did, you would die. So, I alone have a right to do what I want with you. I want you held in captivity on my ring, and I want our psychologists to look at you. Do you understand?" [[(Respond.)|Institutionalized]]It really doesn't matter if you do. You have escaped your life, your worries no longer matter, because they have been replaced with a much more serious future. There will be many new experiences. You will not recognize yourself soon enough. From some perspectives, this is for the best.You cannot move. You're staring into the dark. Someone is on your chair, staring back at you. They look huge. You haven't moved. Your eyes only shine in the dark, have they noticed? Could someone really hate you this much? Your jacket does not move, no matter how much you glare. You feel disappointed.You are on the floor. You've never had a headache this bad. Nothing has ever mattered so much, and nothing matters. Wait, is it really here? Hold on, that's not how this goes. It never goes like this. You never actually- Someone sighs, disappointed. Did you do that? Oh, what are they going to think? No, wait, undo this. You still have to do- everything, you have so much you need to do still. Hang on, this would be great to write about. Yeah, you should, do, that. Rey wouldn't let this happen. Someone has to play your song for Coal. You have to get up. [[(Get up.)]]Your arm is quaking violently as you press your chest off the ground. You can see it from here. There's so much. "Stay still!" someone yells. You're on the ground again. Your chest feels so heavy. Something feels nice. Some gentle, calming pattern. I think it's going to be okay. <<run OnCompletedPlaythrough("Dead")>>\The small creature has jumped back. It's absolutely out of range by this point, and could comfortably outmaneuver you while blind. The disarmed guard has reactively shoved you away, pushing you into an uncontrolled stumble. You had not even seen the other guard draw his weapon, but he has, and he stands there, pointing at you as you regain footing. The world freezes. Nothing moves. [[Continue|Time unfreezes]]You awake. [[That's all?|Kind of comfortable]]Ah, good morning. Oh. Never mind. [[Continue|You feel loved]]Are you crying? Why? ... You don't know, do you? ... Who's name was that? [[It doesn't matter.|You sing a lot]]Every part of you that needs comfort has it, in this position. The blanket cups your chin, isn't pressed into your throat too hard, holds to your heart. You feel loved. You wish your blanket could feel it too. [[That's nice.|Are you crying?]]You sing a lot, when you're alone. Especially in bed. Though, it's more like humming. [[Continue|Time is slow]]The second hand ticks so slowly. How are you doing that? [[Continue|Stellar hole]]Hey. You're not moving. Are you dead yet? They will excavate your fossil when it's all over, forever frozen in this curled position. [[Continue|A day at a time]]Each one is an achievement. You just need to wait it out. How long? Just focus on today. That's all you can do. Stay intact. [[Continue|Drooling]]What do you need? Oh. I'm sorry. [[Continue|The time]]What's the time? Oh. Again? At least you're still here. <<endRun "Sleepless">>Yeah. You're kind of comfortable, I guess. [[Oh.|Awake again]]You've been drooling. Gross. [[Continue|What do you need]]It's nice to see you happy. Whatcha thinking about? The heart of your star was replaced with a tear in space and time. Ah! It doesn't seem it, when you smile. It isn't stopping nor slowing. You gave up bargaining. You can't imagine it ending any other way, any later, no matter how much you shine. Should you tell them? [[I can't.|Fossilized]]You've seen them about, from time to time. These are people you do not connect with at all. They're trying to be nice, but the conversation is unbearably awkward. They cannot help you.I think one thing I'd like to make clear is that I'm a very loving person. I might not want to bang you, but you're someone I care about greatly. That is something I've learned is very difficult for me to stop doing, even when it's vital I should. I feel that way about most of my friends. So like, regardless of how I act in any one moment, I care a lot about you.You live exclusively in extremes, a permanent wave traced through you entire life. It wasn't that long ago you excelled. Everyone loved you, you loved yourself, you were the best at everything, you created music and art and twenty thousand words in a week - you found love, //real// love like you'd never felt before, you reconnected with everyone you'd lost, you made up for everything! You weren't sleeping, that's fine, they were cheering you on, you got everything done, you needed more hours, you needed to stay in this moment, you needed to keep your momentum. You had finally figured yourself out. It took decades, but you were finally, finally so so free, it was all so clear. You loved life itself. You had never been happier. An impossible wave of energy, crashed directly into a wall, stopped in a single instant. I can't believe you survived! If that's what you call this. You're unrecognizable. You shouldn't be surprised. No matter how fast your mind runs, you never escape the impossible balance. How did you ever get so much momentum? You're slipping, you're going backwards, you've undone everything already and it isn't slowing down. You can never be that person again. Knowing you ever could have been is divine cruelty.What stays with you to this day is the look in her eyes. Anger, fear, madness and most of all, sadness. Hers was a mind collapsed inwards by the strain of impossible demands in an uncaring world. She was lost, without the smallest of reliefs, and entirely without hope. You had never imagined that you would see those eyes again, many years later, in your own mirror. You have no mirror, now."Yep."You meet an individual in a bookshop, possibly the owner, who is greatly into astronomy. They will talk with you about it whether you want them to or not. Their "knowledge" comes from various sources; struggling to understand scientific concepts much more advanced than they're prepared for; from ancient religious beliefs about the stars; from interviews with strangers; from astrological readings from magazines. They've put a lot of work and imagination into acquiring the understanding they have, It's something they're proud of. Their misinformation includes: - No idea there are other planets - Complete misunderstanding of black holes - Personal theory of why the cryogenium happened, involving the local star (it has some element of truth to it) - Believes lightning comes from the sun. "If you could see past the clouds, actually what you'd find is that, you know the lightning you constantly see? It actually really comes from the sun." - - Calls it astrology Depending on your disposition at the time, you'll: - (acumen) Ignore them/turn them away, understanding what they say is entirely wrong and believing them to be devoid of value. - (psyche) Argue with them because you know better. - (heart) listen to them in spite of your beliefs otherwise. - If you brought your astronomy book from home, you can give it to them. They'll go away and read it while you look for a book. Reading this book shatters their passion, and they quietly ask you to take it away with you. "Oh man, you're in for a treat. I'm actually the leading professional." "Okay so, we live in this big field right. You have us, in the middle, and on the edge of the sky you have these things called stars. Some of them are bigger than others, but they're all the same kind of power. So how does that work?? Well this gets into a really cool thing called astrology, which is the study of how stars affect us! The smaller ones, they're smaller because they affect us in ways that we can't really see. But if you look ''really'' closely, you can actually see the lines between them that shows the kinds of nets they cast. They look a bit like animals. These nets have different effects on different people, and they put a lot of time and argument into figuring out exactly how this works. I think a part of the cryogenium was that, when the sky was blocked out to protect us, the stars couldn't affect us properly, and being that they were adapted to the presence of the stars, it sent almost everyone insane, except those who spend a lot of time away from stars, like us! So I guess stars are, kind of evil, in a way? I'm not sure, but I'm also not terribly interested in finding out!!" "Oh! Yeah, I know that. So lightning is actually made of this thing called "plasma". Do you know where you also find plasma? In stars! Most of them don't have enough of it to reach us, but the sun, which was a special star that spends most of its energy on heat rather than influence, produced a huge amount of it, so much that it would sometimes hit us. Actually, this links directly into the cryogenium - when the sun started to grow, to compensate the planet started to produce more clouds to shield us from the lightning. Clouds always form to block lightning, because if it didn't we'd be completely destroyed when the plasma hits us. That's why there's so many." "Well a lot of this I figured out myself. I spend a lot of time reading, obviously, hehe." "Oh well, a lot of stuff. Astrology is pretty easy to learn about compared to most of it, they had daily books that spoke about it. It was as crucial to society as any daily event. There are some ancient books that have really good insights too! They're weirdly common for how old they are. They made these things called papers, where they'd talk about what they figured out. Dumb name, because paper is used for a lot of other things. Anyway, most of it is pretty useless. I tried to interview people before too but like, it turns out most people barely know anything about the outside world. They just, never asked their parents about it?? Or their parents never asked their parents, or- you know. You'd think someone would know anything, right?!" <<acumenTalk "Low">> Now that you think of it, what lies beyond doesn't come up much. You have skimmed pages about it before, and what you saw was totally different. She is //very// certain, and in the best position to know. Why would you know better?Throughout the world is a variety of small, wild pets. One of these is a spy for the upper volcano. Tapp is aware of this spy, and makes hint to it if you gain his trust.Endless opening which starts similarly, but gives you only one first thought, which gives you different skills, showing that your mindset is not always what you experience in this game.<<heartTalk "Extreme">> Yes, this is exactly it. A letter! They can read when they feel ready. They don't have to see you. It'll be something they can hold on to, remember you by. You still have a chance. [[(Write to them.)]]A sigh. Not quite relief, not quite sadness. It is the sigh of someone who breaks their mirror. You know what you are. 'It isn't good', and you know that too. But there is certainty in this horrible truth. You have accepted it as a part of you. You have control. You have relief. Relief, however small. That's all this is. You lower your sleeve before the frost can bite you too. [[Continue|Into the sunset]]You had hoped you could wordlessly walk off into the sunset, have your credits roll, and be done with this story. The reality is that now you're sitting in the middle of nowhere, thinking about the same things you usually do. No one has noticed, no one cares, and nothing has changed. You're just sad somewhere else, at the end of a dissociative fugue. Worst of all, you've ignored your limits. You're far from home, you're tired, you're thirsty, you're freezing, you feel awful, and there is no one to help. [[Continue|You're dying]]The elements are attacking you where you're weakest: your willpower. You just want to sit down, and rest. To not think about what that means. You can't feet your toes, or your nose. You're redirecting your breath into your hands and face to conserve what little heat you can. You want to run down this hill, but you can barely manage a walk. [[(Keep walking.)|Keep walking]] [[(Stop walking.)|Rest close to outpost]]Your mind seems to cloud over. You can't imagine what would be worth all of this effort. What's back there that you're returning to? You can only grasp at faint, meaningless mundanities, like laying in bed, and doing chores. That's the life you'll return to. [[(Stop.)|Rest close to outpost]] [[(Resist.)|Resist]]And even in your last moments, you force yourself to suffer unnecessarily. This could be your best chance. It's exactly what you wanted. Gentle. Peaceful. You'll just sleep, and it'll be okay. Did you //really// bring yourself all this way just to go back worse off? How little do you know yourself? [[(Rest.)|Rest close to outpost]] [[(Persist.)|Persist]]<<if $psyche >= 2>>\ <<include [[Prove it to yourself]]>> <<else>>\ <<include [[Not in your control]]>> <</if>>\ [[(Give up.)|Rest close to outpost]] <<if $psyche >= 2>>\ [[(Refuse.)|Refuse to give up]] <</if>>\- You awake to Molen, who has covered you in their expedition clothes and is trying to warm you up. The outcome isn't important. You need to prove to yourself that you don't give up! You need to prove it wasn't your fault. You always tried, prove it. Make sure they know.<<psycheTalk "Low">> You've got nothing more to give. You just aren't enough. It paid off. <<timed 1000ms t8n>><<adorationTalk "Candid">>'Hey, <<timed 1000ms t8n>>I <<timed 200ms t8n>>love <<timed 200ms t8n>>you, <<timed 800ms t8n>>so <<timed 800ms t8n>>fucking <<timed 800ms t8n>>much-' <<timed 1000ms t8n>>No, not right now, <<timed 1000ms t8n>>it isn't going anywhere, <<timed 1000ms t8n>>you have time. <<timed 2000ms t8n>>You're laughing. <<timed 750ms t8n>>They don't know why, but they're happy to see it. <<timed 750ms t8n>>They laugh too. <<timed 750ms t8n>>Stay in this moment.` <<timed 1500ms t8n>>How could they even exist? <<timed 1000ms t8n>>You're shaking, can they tell? <<timed 1500ms t8n>>Yeah, they can tell, <<timed 1000ms t8n>>that's good. <<timed 1000ms t8n>>Stay in this moment. <<timed 300ms t8n>>You can't breathe. <<timed 1000ms t8n>>Huh, that's funny... <<timed 1500ms t8n>>It's perfect. <<timed 1500ms t8n>>Just stay here. <<timed 2000ms t8n>>"Hah, <<timed 1000ms t8n>>ah, <<timed 750ms t8n>>I love you, <<timed 200ms t8n>>too!" <<timed 1000ms>> <!-- Sort of a reimplementation of endRun, because it needs to end automatically --> <<run OnCompletedPlaythrough("Comfortable")>> <<include "VariableInit">> <<goto "Again.">> <</timed>><</timed>><</timed>><</timed>><</timed>><</timed>><</timed>><</timed>><</timed>><</timed>><</timed>><</timed>><</timed>><</timed>><</timed>><</timed>><</timed>><</timed>><</timed>><</timed>><</timed>><</timed>><</timed>><</timed>><</timed>><</timed>><</timed>><</timed>><</timed>><</timed>><</timed>><</timed>><</timed>>You can't just walk away and disappear. Something has to happen. You're dying. Slowly. It will take hours, but even with those hours you don't know if you can survive, no matter what you do. <<if $heart <= 1>>\ <<include [[You're not you]]>> <</if>> [[(Start walking back.)|Walk back]] [[(Stay sitting.)|Rest far from outpost]]<<heartTalk "Low">> It's okay. This is how it's meant to go. You know there's only one way a story like yours ends. If it isn't now, it'll be tomorrow. Or the day after. It doesn't make a difference. You're not you, anymore. You watched yourself die already. Some things can't be fixed. There's nothing to save.You do not notice how long you have been walking for. The monotony has lead you into a hypnotised state. [[Continue|Not thinking]]You are not thinking. You're not reasoning. Something fundamental pushes you forward. You feel numb, and that feels good. You don't like blinking because it brings you back for a moment. Your mouth is slightly parted, and you can feel your tongue drying from the growing wind, but that's okay. [[Continue|You escape]] Every step sets you free. [[Continue|Back to reality]]You fade back into reality. Something is happening. You rarely experienced before, in the sheltered life you fled. You're freezing. And now that you think about it, you're tired. Have you ever walked this far before? How long were you walking? Where are you? You decide it's best to sit down for a bit. [[Continue|Cold]]You're so cold your muscles are aching. A shiver is starting to roll through you. The ground below you is sapping any energy your rest regains. It's not like you came unprepared: gloves, a long sleeved shirt, a thick jacket. It's how you always dress. Nowadays. You lean your head back against the frozen rock wall. ... You do not have short sleeved shirts anymore. [[(Pull back your sleeves.)|Pull back your sleeve]]You want to feel something, and believing you can't feel good, you want to hurt. Stopping myself from drinking tonight is difficult."Do you... want them back? As something big in your life?" It's obvious what he means. The answer is reflexive, candid. "[[No.|I don't]]"He looks surprised, almost. You continue. "I mean, the thought comes up sometimes." "I didn't know them really. I guess that's obvious." "I've made so many mistakes." "They wouldn't make me happy. But, it might, ..." "I loved them. Not just as a partner. I want to believe that means something." "I've never been able to say good bye. Not once." "I can't." You didn't speak. A vein was tapped, and it poured. [[Continue|That's rough]]"That's... rough... I don't know what else to say." You keep sitting together, quietly. The world seems paused, waiting for something that doesn't come. [[Continue|People love you]]"I want to, too. For you. For them. For me." Another pause. "People love you. They just don't all express it the same way. Don't know how to, sometimes."You scrutinize every word, rewriting threefold what you write, ensuring each letter is as loved as you tell yourself you must one day be. Some day, it might be a perfect capture of your being. Who, where, what you were, before you disappear, dead or changed, and perhaps someone somewhere sometime will care. Maybe it's futile to paint a scene that changes each time you look. [[Continue|Into bed]]You dive into bed excitedly, a stupid grin covering your face. This is the third time tonight, but this time you're ready to finish the day. You don't know what the time is. You briefly acknowledge that you have spent yet another day entirely alone, and reject the thought. [[(Rest...)|Wake up from drinking]]Why can't that be who you are, normally? Is this what growing old is? Many more colours of such subtle shades, but none of them are nearly as intense. Is that good? Or will it all just become tones of grey? Wait and see. Decades will tell. Can you manage that? The odds aren't good. You have done this dozens of times. You depise that this is the happiest you can be. Good night. See you again soon. <<endRun "Atypical">>A smaller, playable section that occasionally replaces your usual opening. A flashback to an earlier, better time in your life where everything was perfect and you excelled. Its runs would be dramatically shorter to represent the racing of your mind. Everything is described as a blur of sensations and snapshots. A key point of this is that, being set at a different time, it would allow you to see some of the same places and events from a different perspective. Some ideas: - Working your job as a doctor. - Going to the outpost and excitedly interviewing the explorers. - Visiting not-yet-ex - Hanging out with friends. - Studying something, possibly in an actual community class, and uncovering what you believe to be a fundamental truth about the universe. - Excitedly exploring the city. - Being compelled to an act of absurd generosity at great cost, e.g. buying lots of expensive stuff and distributing them to people freely. - Picking up a brand new hobby you have no talent in but are sure you can excel in. [[Cork hobby]] [[Explorer interview]] [[The decline]]The world around you stops. Your eyes fix sharp enough to cut the air. Nothing else is visible: A block of cork, a pair of knives. This is perfect. The possibilities explode before your vision; You can create miniature statues of your friends, posed in scenes that capture their soul in the size of your hand. You can figure out how to paint them, too. You can make your own bottle corks. You can learn to make your own glass. You can ferment your own brew. You can scatter these freely among the public, become a legendary figure of unparalleled talent and value. You can do this. You're not like others. It'll only take you a of couple months. Then you can move onto even more.You don't know any of the people here today. Not that you should, you don't know anyone who works here. The variety of being here is staggingly stagnant. Beyond colour and texture, the occasional variation in snout or paw or ear, they all appear as fat balls of fluff, to you. They are all entirely naked, but despite your intent searching, you cannot identify a single genital. "Why, do you want to know that?" You explained yourself five times already, with many different words, metaphors, tangents, and stories from your childhood. It seems impossible that they can't keep up at this point. "Who are you?" asks one. You stand there for a moment, mouth slightly parted. There is no way you could ever answer this question to this person at this moment. - "Why??" They let out a single, certain "HA!" "A walking poem, huh? Don't think you mean harm, but they'll see harm. Think you should get going, 'Poe." - Keep questioning people. - Leave. Before long you're asked to leave by a very kind and very well armed looking gentleman. - Question the well armed gentleman about his life. What a strange look on his face! "Thank you for your interest! But please, do not return." He does not wait for you to respond before reentering the outpost, softly shutting the door, followed by a gentle "click" that brings a certain end to your investigative journalism.<!-- TODO: Timing? -->\ <<alignRight>><<classDiv "acumenColor">>There is a particular loneliness and terror in this kind of madness.<</classDiv>><</alignRight>>\ <<classDiv "psycheColor">>You had run so far.<</classDiv>>\ <<alignRight>><<classDiv "acumenColor">>//What did you do!?// When will it happen again - will it happen again - are you stuck - is this it?<</classDiv>><</alignRight>>\ <<classDiv "psycheColor">>You thought you were free.<</classDiv>>\ <<alignRight>><<classDiv "acumenColor">>What are you?<</classDiv>><</alignRight>>\ <<classDiv "psycheColor">>Your reality had shattered in a single moment.<</classDiv>>\ <<alignRight>><<classDiv "acumenColor">>Are you the chaotic, impulsive and thoughtless tornado of boundless energy and no judgement?<</classDiv>><</alignRight>>\ <<classDiv "psycheColor">>You refused to believe it had happened. You felt weightless as you fell.<</classDiv>>\ <<alignRight>><<classDiv "acumenColor">>Or the somber, quiet, withdrawn, exhausted and suicidal husk?<</classDiv>><</alignRight>>\ <<classDiv "psycheColor">>Maybe, it was going to be okay. You had summited heights never imagined. Maybe you could fall forever.<</classDiv>>\ <<alignRight>><<classDiv "acumenColor">>Probably, a bit of both. Till the shards became rain.<</classDiv>>\ <div style="text-align: center" class="heartColor">You're just not meant to be happy.</div>\- The two of you hang out, do some minor crimes together. If it goes well, you end up with them somewhere (their house? somewhere quiet?) listening to music on a stolen device together. It's a quiet moment where both of you are feeling your own things. They are suffering with a loss, too, of a different kind. They won't tell you much about it. Crimes might include: Petty theft, vandalism, graffiti. They have a sheet of raw pasta in their back pocket they eat. They confide about their plans to unveil a major piece of graffiti in the town. "I like you. Wanna hang out?" - You like me? Why? "I dunno, you dress good, you like the art. Seem like my type." - Romantically? "Nah. No one is." - I think I just wanna be alone today. "Honestly? I respect that. I get that. You, take care." - You know what, I'm down. What're you thinking? Since when do you say 'I'm down?' - In another route, you find some of their graffiti around the town. "Why, you looking? I don't do it, but I know some people."Here again, are you? Last time, you were cold-blood in your resolve to leave no hint of your intentions. You had a plan, you set a date, you would behave totally normal, elevated until the time came. The time came. You disappeared. You returned. No one knew. This time, there is no one who could know, or notice.You are fire. You are the destruction, and creation. This inferno takes the same life it gives. It consumes the tinder of your soul for impossible passion that no combination of words could capture. It is your driving force; It is your agony. Fortunately, blood of fire comes with benefits.The theories, questions, conjectures, projections, hopes, were instantly silenced. They told you it had rained. For the first time, you could hear the storm. The terrible whirling and ripping. Where was your courage? Your unrelenting, naive, moronic courage to spit in the face of death as it brings down the scythe, certain it would stop short, or bounce off? You are exactly the kind of person this happens to. You stared into the distance. Nothing in your expression had changed. You cried silently. You held your breath. You bit your cheeks and your lips. You forced more air into your lungs to crush the wave. "Yeah." Inaudible. You left. No one could be around for this. You don't remember what came next.To find someone who understands your pain is a rare thing. To find someone who wants to help is divine chance. To find someone who can help? I haven't. How have I dealt with my traumas? Mostly, I haven't. They are still with me. I've only been able to grow, so that they become a smaller part of me. I read, I think, I experience new things, I talk a lot. It's gotten me somewhere; it hasn't fixed me.Tick. <<timed 1s t8n>>Tick. <<timed 1s t8n>>Tick. <<timed 1s t8n>>Tick.<<timed 1s t8n>> How much time do you have left? How much longer can you spend searching? Will you have enough time to make a discovery matter? With every passing second, hope dies a little more. Your chances get a little slimmer, and your future loses a little more potential. You simply cannot imagine a world in which things could turn out okay. You're stuck in a perpetual trauma loop. You only feel alive when you tap into the stream of agony in those memories. What killed you has become your only source of meaning. <</timed>><</timed>><</timed>><</timed>>"If there was some way to get them back, would it really fix anything? It won't change the way they are, or the things they did." <<if $heart >= 1>> <<heartTalk "Medium">> Or the things you did... <</if>>\ "You told me enough to know it was never perfect. I think it would just, happen again, if they came back right now. You would both need a lot of time, to heal and to change... and who knows who you'll be, once you've had that time. You won't be the same person you are now. You won't stay like this. Things will get better." A pause. "I promise." It was you who said those words, once. Somewhere, you ''must'' believe them. Right now, you feel like you could never change, have never changed, for better and certainly for worse. One person truly believing in you makes the future feel a lot less terrifying. "[[It's hard for me to believe that. I'll try to remember that you believe it. Thank you.]]"You think back on everything you went through, relive it directly, point by point. You convince yourself that it wasn't really that bad. You're just weak. But now, you remember. All of the words that were said. The ones that weren't. You remember the silence as you wept. You remember the attacks you repeatedly received at your lowest possible points. You begged for relief, and you were kicked away. You have been shown how little you matter to those you loved the most. Is there any wonder you became this animal?You've been so alone. When you tried for help, you found no one could understand what you'd been through. They didn't know why you were so hurt, or how you were hurt, and any attempt to justify your feelings felt tangled and confused. You don't even understand it, not fully. After what happened, the world has become cleanly divided in two: those who understand this trauma, and those that don't. What can you even say to someone who doesn't get it? Surrounded by people who surely care, who can't do a thing. You just have to keep it to yourself. But this person, you feel like they understand it. Maybe because they have no idea who you are.[[Where does the food come from?]] [[]]"Are you being daft?"In the middle of the alley she stop suddenly, turns around, somewhat uncomfortably close. "You like music?" You nod. From a small hole in the wall by her feet, obscured by shadow and paint, she pulls out a... something. It holds music. You've never actually seen one of these in person, only heard about them. Heard about them, in the hands of the elite exclusively. "[[How the hell could you afford that?]]" "[[Did you steal that?]]" "[[Do you know how much trouble that could get you in??]]""Yeah, why. What does it mean to you. That's what I wanna know." "[[I long to live in a world that cannot exist.]]" "[[It's the only way I can make sense of myself.]]" "[[It's just what I'm good at.]]" "[[I want it all to mean something. "No one gets that. No one realizes how, fucked, all of this is." She stamps. "It's just acts. They don't understand it. They're just pretending. They can't feel it... It's, just... Just, impossible." As the first notes of the song begin, you take in your surroundings. This alley feels like a dead zone, totally separate from the city itself. The architecture is odd and awkward, there are no sights to match to the distant sounds of people. It's unusually well looked after, though not inviting. There is graffiti everywhere, some of which clearly belongs to Kay. The music is different. Otherworldly. Ambient. Conflict and peace weaving through each other. Not what you imagined she would like. Or what you though you'd like, but you do. Time holds no power here. Both of you live in your own satellite galaxies, tracing the path of stars as scars with music to help map these astronomical emotions. Slowly, the music fades out, the stars dim, and are overtaken once more by the bustle of life. [[Continue|Taking notes]]You can't keep yourself. You need to record these feelings while they're raw. I didn't take offence." <<heartTalk "Extreme">> It's impossible to convince yourself of that. <<getDialogueOptions "Ari options">>\ {/Dialogue}\Acumen is your ability to think about the world around you logically. Low: Acumen is unable to trust anyone. You can't think of simple, logical answers to what is happening in front of you, rather opting to see the largest potential danger available. Medium: Acumen begins to support day-to-day activities, but still frequently finds itself insufficient at solving problems. Manipulative ideas are only briefly considered before being discarded. High: Acumen begins to overtake emotions, encouraging behaviours that are immoral and manipulative. It can absorb powerful blows to the spirit by using logic to work around the emotions they bring up. Acumen is able to draw upon intellect accurately and quickly. Extreme: Acumen begins to believe every judgement it makes is correct, and can make wild leaps in logic. It is incredibly manipulative, and sees an opportunity to gain and control in every situation it encounters.Psyche is your belief that you are in control of the world around you, that you can make a difference, and channels your impulses. It is concerned with simple, immediate answers, like sex, anger, and determination. Low: Psyche is despondent, and has no belief that anything you do can make a difference. Concepts like fate and karma are used to justify inaction. If the spirit is challenged, psyche will fold, and be damaged. Medium: Psyche starts to believe it deserves better than it has. It recalls some of the protagonist's better moments as proof, but maintains doubt over their value and influence, and can be bested by difficult moments - of which there are many. High: Psyche starts to become impulsive. Urges like sex and domination start to manifest at inappropriate times. Psyche allows the spirit to power through tough situations by avoiding thinking of the future. Any small victory is worth celebrating, and any defeat is worth ignoring. Extreme: Psyche begins to demean those around them, and is persistent in wanting to fulfil desires. It does not think of repercussions.Heart is your ability to understand yourself, and the people around you. It is empathy, introspection, love, passion. Low: Heart is highly insecure, quick to blame faults on the failings of the protagonist's character. It is racked with guilt and shame, constantly harming itself with memories of the past. It struggles to get an accurate measure on others and its self, choosing the worst possible interpretation for any scenario. It mostly focuses on itself, and the pains it has experienced. It struggles to let anyone close out of terror, but so desperately wants them to be close. It believes the world is better off without them in it, opting to avoid, remove, flee, die. Medium: Heart starts to think more of others, and is no longer constantly pulled towards the worst interpretations. It is beginning to re-form connections with others. High: Heart cares greatly about all of those around it, and is able to understand what people are experiencing very accurately. Guilt comes less often, but in stronger waves. It becomes slightly masochistic, willing harm itself if it can reason it will improve the life of someone it cares about. It thinks a lot about the past, and the mistakes that have been made, trying to find answers. Extreme: Every emotion is heightened, and Heart is passionate anything related to the emotions. It finds love for everyone. Emotions come quickly, and fade just as quickly, often causing regret at acting too quickly. It is eager and impatient.They are terrified of what you might say. You finally have control, and it feels //amazing.// It's time for you to feel some ''relief.''<!-- TODO: Being able to check if a passage has been visited would be very useful for cleaning code like this up.
